commands: uv run --with nibabel==5.4.2 --with fslpy==3.29.1 --with numpy python tools/transform/generate_freesurfer_oracle.py
notes: Self-consistency: the LTA/register.dat/xfm files are written by this generator from FreeSurfer transform.cpp/mri.cpp semantics (see generator docstring), not by FreeSurfer or an independent implementation. points.tsv: reference RAS points and the movable RAS point each maps to under the pullback; every file here encodes that one transform. Reference-implementation inputs: Torig from nibabel get_vox2ras_tkr; FSLREG matrix from fslpy toFlirt. Cross-implementation: nitransforms reads ras2ras.lta and vox2vox.lta in ../nitransforms_crosscheck. PENDING (P4.02): native lta_convert / tkregister2 / mri_vol2vol outputs.
